digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Monday, October 5 has four live meetings, two protected or administrative blocks, four carried-over actions, and four urgent items. The day’s priorities are reconciling the Amazon Connect user and Quick Connect source lists before the 2:30 PM resourcing session, locking the Attorney Review UAT and training path for the October 15 launch, clearing timecards and the Q3 Legacy Award nomination deadline, and resolving tomorrow morning’s three-way conflict. The clearest delivery risk is Amazon Connect: offboarded users appear to have been re-added from an older list, and a key First Fire contact is out today. The GitHub completion snapshot was last updated September 30, so carry-over has been kept conservative.

items.label: Set the Amazon Connect recovery and build-ownership plan
items.detail: The latest Teams thread shows conflicting user lists and offboarded employees re-added as Quick Connects. Use the 10:30 AM standup to establish the authoritative roster and cleanup owner, then use the 2:30 PM resourcing session to assign the remaining queue, flow, skills, automation, and documentation work. Josh is out today, so confirm substitute First Fire coverage.

items.label: Lock the Attorney Review UAT and training path
items.detail: Friday’s clarification unblocked development: the ticket should link to the intake record, attorneys resolve it, and intake closes it after communicating the decision. Confirm the build and QA dates needed for October 9 UAT, plus the roster owner and training deadline for the October 15 launch.

items.label: Plan the five downward reviews
items.detail: The five reviews are due October 15. Reserve writing time this week and collect prior-manager input where required so the final reviews reflect both managers’ feedback.

items.label: Complete the overdue harassment-prevention training
items.detail: The Dominican Republic EOR course remains an aging open item. Complete it or confirm with HR why it is still assigned before another cycle passes.

items.label: 8:00 AM - Approve timecards and prepare the week
items.detail: Clear payroll approvals and use the block to set the week’s review, Amazon Connect, and Attorney Review priorities before meetings begin.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Amazon Connect daily standup
items.detail: Set the authoritative user list, cleanup owner, and substitute coverage for the open Quick Connect and build work.

items.label: Noon - Protected work block
items.detail: Use the uninterrupted hour for timecards, the Legacy Award deadline, and preparation for the afternoon decision sequence.

items.label: 2:00-3:30 PM - BD portfolio, Amazon Connect resourcing, and Maria 1:1
items.detail: Three back-to-back meetings leave no transition time. Bring the portfolio blockers into the resourcing decision, then use Maria’s one-on-one to settle roadblocks and owners.

items.label: 4:00 PM - Post-go-live review canceled
items.detail: The cancellation opens a useful focus window for documenting Amazon Connect owners and resolving tomorrow morning’s coverage conflict.

items.label: Approve timecards and set the week’s operating priorities
items.detail: Use the 8:00 AM block to clear approvals and identify the decisions Jean needs from today’s Amazon Connect and portfolio meetings.

items.label: Submit the Q3 Legacy Award nomination by EOD
items.detail: Leadership’s nomination window closes today. Gather any final team input and submit the nomination before the end-of-day deadline.

items.label: Resolve tomorrow morning’s three-way conflict
items.detail: The 10:00 AM Attorney Review working session overlaps both the 10:30 AM Jhara one-on-one and the 10:30 AM Amazon Connect standup. Choose coverage today so the October 15 launch and deployment work both return clear decisions.

items.label: Decide Skye Austin’s document edit requests
items.detail: Review the four access requests for the VAWA AOS, Asylum, Naturalization, and I-751 case decks, confirm the appropriate permission level, and approve or decline them together.

items.label: Sara is out this morning
items.detail: She expects to be online around 11:00 AM Pacific; route anything time-sensitive before then through available leadership coverage.

items.label: Josh Ellis is out today
items.detail: Confirm alternate First Fire coverage for the Amazon Connect list cleanup and build assignments before the 2:30 PM resourcing session.

items.label: 10:00 AM - Attorney Review working session starts a three-way conflict
items.detail: The session runs through 11:00 AM while the Jhara one-on-one and Amazon Connect standup both begin at 10:30 AM. Assign coverage today.

items.label: 11:00 AM - Executive-slide focus block
items.detail: Protect the 30 minutes for the EPMO weekly-meeting slides before the noon work block.

items.label: 2:00 PM - EPMO team-lead weekly catch-up
items.detail: Bring portfolio changes, risks, milestones, and any unresolved Amazon Connect or Attorney Review ownership decisions.

items.label: 3:30 PM - Nicolas 1:1
items.detail: Use the one-on-one to close any ownership or portfolio roadblocks coming out of the team-lead discussion.
